prayerExcerpt.en-US: "We are ready to die rather than to transgress the laws of God!" exclaimed one of the Machabees. This sentiment should ever be that of a Christian in presence of temptation.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Estamos prontos a morrer antes que transgredir as leis de Deus!" exclamou um dos Macabeus. Este sentimento deve ser sempre o de um cristão em presença da tentação.

meta.face: A veteran of about forty-five with a sun-browned, ruddy olive complexion and a ROUND, SHORT face as wide as it is long on a THICK neck — a broad, rounded forehead, FULL, firm, ROUNDED cheeks, a SHORT, slightly UPTURNED nose, ROUND, light-brown eyes, frank and steady, under STRAIGHT, thick brown brows, a WIDE, good-humoured mouth, a round chin with a DIMPLE; brown hair going grey, cut very short in the soldier's fashion; a SHORT, close-trimmed grizzled beard; the look firm and open. Not the angular, cleft-chinned victor_marseilles, the long-headed, joined-browed romanus_ostiarius, the square, broken-nosed Tarachus of tarachus_companions, the dark, long-oval Maurice of theban_legion, or george and sebastian.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The book and the Martyrology tell of his throwing down his belt and arms before the standards on the emperor's feast; the book's engraving shows him among soldiers and tents with his arms on the ground. The round, open face is a veteran's, chosen to stand apart from the batch's other soldiers.
